purpose: Machine-readable directory route audit status for de-duplication, fee control, product-surface separation, and externally verifiable lifecycle tracking.
countingRule: An audit or prepared package is not a submission, acceptance, or publication. Count a submitted or published state only when a confirmation receipt or live URL is independently observable.
